tweets.text:
We noticed a new Tesla software update 2026.8.200 (factory update) on a Tesla vehicle (2026). View the rollout of this update here: teslascope.com/software/2026…

Factory updates are available to recently delivered vehicles only.

Our own HW3 vehicle (a 2018 Model 3 Performance) is also included in this initial wave.

We've received several reports that this download was initiated over cellular, suggesting it contains critical security fixes. AI4 vehicles on 2026.2.9.10 will receive these fixes very soon.

2026.14.6 is going out en masse to HW3 and AI4 vehicles, which contains security improvements (in addition to the Spring Update features from 2026.14.3).

Here's a breakdown of the specific models receiving the update, along with the release notes.

Usage of FSD V14.3.2 is looking great on 2026.2.9.10:

37.5% of drivers use FSD, and it is activated for an average of 88.8% of each drive.

In 2026.2.9.1 (V14.2.2.5), FSD was used by 22.2% of drivers, at 86.6% self-driven.

A 0.7x increase in utilization is a fantastic sign.
